implementation: Newly rebuilt source; not recovery of the earlier tested Git tree.

alness.label: Highland Council Alness and Invergordon transport study
alness.verification: Direct PDF read; 2021 study. Used for town geography, B817, High Street, harbour and named employment areas. Proposed improvements are not represented as completed.

tain.label: Highland Council Tain town centre study
tain.verification: Direct PDF read; 2014 draft action plan. Used only for established town-centre geography, not current traffic rules or completion of proposals.

aviemore.label: Cairngorms National Park Aviemore transport consultation
aviemore.verification: Direct HTML read plus indexed official transport committee extracts. Grampian Road proposals are not treated as completed works.

wick.label: Highland Council Wick streetscape update
wick.verification: Direct HTML read; 21 May 2026 update identifies Bridge Street, High Street and rising-bollard pedestrian-zone design. No assertion that works remain ongoing or all access controls are operational now.

highland.label: Highland Council town centre health checks
highland.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms named Highland town centres including Thurso and Portree; does not establish present street restrictions.

ullapool.label: CalMac Ullapool port information
ullapool.verification: Direct HTML read; identifies Ullapool ferry port and bookable route. No sailing availability queried.

mallaig.label: CalMac Mallaig port information
mallaig.verification: Official indexed extract read; direct page fetch failed. Only Mallaig as port and bookable routes relied on; no check-in times or fares copied.

skye.label: CalMac port directions and Skye bridge guidance
skye.verification: Direct HTML read. Distinguishes Skye bridge from suggested Mallaig-Armadale ferry route and Tarbert Harris from Tarbert Loch Fyne.

moray-free.label: Moray Council parking locations
moray-free.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms named locations in Forres, Buckie, Keith and Lossiemouth. Parking listing is not treated as removal-van permission, a reserved space or a loading bay.

elgin.label: Moray Council Elgin parking information
elgin.verification: Direct HTML read. Used for named Elgin parking areas and distinction between car parks; no current price copied.

aberdeen-travel.label: Aberdeenshire Council town transport locations
aberdeen-travel.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms named town-centre streets and Peterhead interchange. Public transport stops are not presented as permitted van loading.

aberdeen-permit.label: Aberdeenshire Council resident parking guidance
aberdeen-permit.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms a resident permit does not reserve or guarantee a space. No permit price or eligibility claim for the removal vehicle.

northlink.label: NorthLink ferry routes and travel updates
northlink.verification: Direct HTML read of 2026 timetable. Used only for route connections and need to confirm sailing; no departure times, fares or availability published.

northlink-business.label: NorthLink business vehicle booking information
northlink-business.verification: Direct HTML read. Operator states business vehicles must be arranged with freight department. No booking made.

hatston.label: NorthLink Kirkwall Hatston terminal
hatston.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms Kirkwall Hatston terminal; terminal choice must be agreed for the actual route.

shetland.label: Shetland Islands Council access route maps
shetland.verification: Direct HTML read confirms separate Lerwick and Scalloway access maps. These walking/access maps are not van routing permissions.

scalloway.label: Shetland Islands Council Scalloway conservation appraisal
scalloway.verification: Official indexed extract confirms Scalloway west of Lerwick and bay-centred settlement; direct PDF read timed out. No detailed street rules inferred.

hebrides.label: Comhairle nan Eilean Siar island office locations
hebrides.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms Stornoway on Lewis, Tarbert office on Harris, Balivanich on Benbecula, Castlebay on Barra. Council offices are not claimed as company premises.

calmac.label: CalMac route directory
calmac.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms route endpoints including Stornoway-Ullapool, Uig-Tarbert, Uig-Lochmaddy, Oban-Castlebay and Ardmhor-Eriskay; no timetable frequency, current capacity or prices inferred.

helensburgh.label: Argyll and Bute Council Helensburgh parking
helensburgh.verification: Direct HTML read; named car parks and local signs are route-planning references, not proof that a removal vehicle can stop at a property.

campbeltown.label: Argyll and Bute Council Kintyre parking
campbeltown.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms Campbeltown in Kintyre and named local parking locations; no parking entitlement or ferry service assumed.

dunoon.label: Western Ferries vehicle crossing information
dunoon.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms passenger-and-vehicle crossing Hunter's Quay-McInroy's Point. No fares or guaranteed departure published.

rothesay.label: CalMac Wemyss Bay to Rothesay route
rothesay.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms Rothesay-Wemyss Bay and alternative Rhubodach-Colintraive route. Does not establish available vehicle capacity on a chosen day.

bridges.label: Aberdeenshire Council bridge restrictions
bridges.verification: Direct HTML read. Identifies Huntly Railway bridge on A97 Bogie Street and Slug Road Railway bridge on Stonehaven-Banchory route. No numeric clearance copied; current signs and actual vehicle dimensions require checking.

banff.label: Aberdeenshire Council Banff Bridge update
banff.verification: Direct HTML read of June 2026 completion update. Used for A98 Banff Bridge and River Deveron geography; does not imply current closure or a guaranteed clear route.

lerwick.label: NorthLink Lerwick terminal information
lerwick.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms Lerwick terminal at Holmsgarth; no current capacity or sailing availability checked.

uist.label: CalMac North Uist connections
uist.verification: Direct HTML read. Confirms Uig-Lochmaddy and alternative island connections. No ferry connection from Balivanich itself asserted.
